title: Professor Jennifer Doudna explains RNA Therapeutics and DNA Editing
content_html:
Professor Jennifer Doudna explains some of her discoveries in RNA therapeutics and DNA editing at the World Economic Forum.

Read her original publication here - or, if that gets too technical, read this article that delves into the story behind her research.
